      "evidence": "Drops Boost.Test dependencies and platform workarounds across CMake, Guix, and vcpkg.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Removes external dependency baggage and platform workarounds from the build system. As noted in the description, eliminating Boost.Test removes workarounds in Guix and depends, such as signal stack handling issues (#36045), simplifying the build and dependency maintenance."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",

      "rationale": "Mechanical test-framework include updates in IPC test suites do not alter IPC interfaces or architecture."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp purely for test harness macro and include migration.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR does not modify kernel APIs, boundaries, or validation library logic."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Replaces the Boost.Test unit runner with an in-tree test framework in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Replaces external Boost.Test with a dedicated in-tree unit test framework featuring expression decomposition. josibake notes this allows customizing runner behavior to Core's needs, unblocking concurrency improvements and removing barriers to writing unit tests while resolving assertion reporting limitations."
    },
